Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.passwordmanager

Class PasswordVault

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.passwordmanager.PasswordVault
public class PasswordVault extends Object
The unlocked, in-memory vault: an ordered list of PasswordEntry items with the small amount of behaviour the panel needs (add / remove / replace / filter / distinct categories) and the JSON (de)serialisation that VaultEnvelope seals. A vault only exists in memory while the app is unlocked; PasswordManagerPanel clears it (and the derived key) on lock and on auto-lock, so nothing secret outlives the session in a field.

The model is deliberately AWT-free and side-effect free - it never touches the filesystem or a cipher directly - so it is trivially unit-testable. The bytes produced by toJsonBytes() are what gets encrypted; reading them back is fromJsonBytes(byte[]).
